articles.title: DoseRAD2026: A benchmark dataset for AI-accelerated photon and proton dose calculation in radiotherapy
articles.summary: This article introduces the DoseRAD2026 benchmark dataset designed to support research in fast and accurate dose calculation for both CT and MRI-guided radiotherapy. The dataset aims to facilitate the development of AI-driven solutions for real-time adaptive treatment planning.

articles.title: ESTRO-EPTN guidelines for independent dose calculation and log file-based patient-specific quality assurance in scanned particle therapy
articles.summary: The European Society for Radiotherapy and Oncology (ESTRO) and the European Particle Therapy Network (EPTN) have released new guidelines for independent dose calculation and log file-based quality assurance in particle therapy. These recommendations are intended to standardize safety protocols across centers while maintaining rigorous machine QA standards.

articles.title: Spot-wise compensation of proton beam deflection and radiation field deformation in the transverse magnetic field of an in-beam MR scanner
articles.summary: Researchers have developed and validated a spot-wise compensation method for proton beam deflection and radiation field deformation caused by the magnetic field in MR-integrated proton therapy. This work provides a critical step toward the clinical implementation of high-precision image-guided particle therapy.

articles.title: Five-Year Persistent 18F-FAPI-74 Uptake in Radiation-induced Hepatic Fibrosis Following Proton Beam Therapy for Hepatocellular Carcinoma
articles.summary: A case report highlights the use of 18F-FAPI-74 PET in identifying persistent fibroblast activation in radiation-induced hepatic fibrosis five years after proton beam therapy. This finding suggests potential long-term imaging biomarkers for evaluating tissue changes following particle irradiation.

articles.title: Prioritizing Proton Therapy for Pelvic Nodal Irradiation in Prostate Cancer
articles.summary: At the 2026 ASTRO Annual Meeting, clinicians discussed when proton therapy may be most justified over advanced photon approaches for intermediate- to very high-risk prostate cancer, with particular attention to pelvic nodal irradiation and reducing dose to nearby bowel.

articles.title: Stanford Radiation Oncology Showcases Research and Awards at ASTRO 2026
articles.summary: Stanford Cancer Institute highlighted advances presented at ASTRO 2026 spanning AI, cancer treatment, and precision oncology, reflecting the continued integration of computational methods with radiation oncology research.

articles.title: National Proton Conference Highlights Advances and Expanding Access
articles.summary: The National Association for Proton Therapy continues to highlight developments in proton therapy, new clinical programs, technology, and efforts to expand access across the United States.
